title: You Can Play at This Iconic Major Venue (Firestone Country Club)
body:
We have played a lot of golf courses. Walking up to the first tee at Firestone Country Club felt different.

There is pressure when you stand on that first tee at Firestone South. You can feel the history. Tiger Woods won here eight times. Jack Nicklaus won here seven. Arnold Palmer, Rory McIlroy, Dustin Johnson. Every great player you have ever watched on television has walked these same fairways and competed on this same course. That weight is very real and it hits you the second you pull up to the property.

## Course 1 - Firestone South Course
![South Course](https://res.cloudinary.com/dak67vton/image/upload/v1784207069/Firestone_Background_gxxbst.png)
*South Course*
The South Course is the one everyone comes for and it earns every bit of that reputation. Narrow tree lined fairways, immaculate conditions, and a course that demands precision from the very first hole. There is not a lot of room to miss on the South Course and you feel that immediately.

It has hosted the PGA Championship three times, the World Golf Championships from 1962 through 2018, and currently hosts the Kaulig Companies Championship, one of five majors on the PGA Tour Champions. Over 70 professional tournaments have been played here. The pedigree of this course is unlike almost anything else in American golf.

Then there is hole 16. Arnold Palmer took an eight on it during the 1960 PGA Championship and called it The Monster. The name stuck so hard that the entire South Course now carries that nickname. From the back tees it plays 667 yards, the longest hole on the property and one of the most demanding holes in championship golf. We played it, we did not score well, and we completely understood why Palmer felt the way he did.

## Courses 2 & 3 - North & Fazio Courses
![North Course](https://res.cloudinary.com/dak67vton/image/upload/v1784206889/North_Final_Picture_Firestone_gfrz9a.png)
*North Course*
The North Course was our personal favorite and it is the most scenic of the three. Water is everywhere from the moment you step onto the first tee and it never really goes away. As the course climbs in elevation you can see the entire property, the famous Firestone water tower, and holes of the South Course below you. Hole 17 is a par 3 over a peninsula green with water surrounding it on three sides. Hole 18 is one of the best finishing holes on the property with a forced carry over water and the approach playing alongside the lake all the way to the green. Our villa sat right behind that 18th green and watching groups finish their rounds from the balcony was awesome.

The Fazio Course feels like a completely different world. The minute you drive up to the first tee it feels more secluded, more peaceful, and immediately different from the parkland style of the South and North. It leans more links inspired with different trees and a completely different vibe. Hole 7 is a par 3 from an elevated tee box down into a beautiful green surrounded by trees. The seclusion you feel on that tee is one of the best moments of the entire trip. All three courses are within close proximity on the property and yet each one gives you a completely different day of golf.

## The Experience - This Trip is Special
 
The caddies at Firestone are exceptional. Ours was sprinting back and forth grabbing clubs, reading putts, and making sure we had every piece of information we needed on every hole. On courses this demanding for the first time, we highly recommend using a caddie.

The accommodations matched the golf. Our villa sat right off the lake on the 18th fairway of the North Course with a pool table, poker chips on the dining table, a full kitchen, and a balcony overlooking the water. When we opened the door we were blown away. The dining is equally well covered. Early tee time and need to get out fast? They have grab and go breakfast ready for you. Want a full sit down experience? They have that too. 

## Two Ways to Get On - Stay & Play / National Membership
 
The Stay and Play package is how we did it and how most golfers will access Firestone. Non members can book accommodations on the property and get full access to all three courses as a guest. [Click here to see all the details!](https://www.invitedclubs.com/clubs/firestone-country-club/stay-play/?contactType=membership&ic_inquiry_type=Membership&ic_club_code=00674&ic_campaign_source=Meta&ic_promo_type=Influencer&ic_campaign_description=CoursesYouNeedtoPlay )
![Stay & Play Villa](https://res.cloudinary.com/dak67vton/image/upload/v1784207080/Stay_and_Play_Villa_llhgb7.jpg)
*Stay & Play Villa*
Here is the detail that blew our minds though. You can become a national member at Firestone Country Club for as little as $5,000. If you do not live locally in the Akron area this option is available to you and it gives you full member access to all three courses and the entire property. But it goes further than that. That $5,000 kicks you off to access to the full Invited network of private clubs around the country plus partnership access to Troon managed courses with member discounts. For any serious golfer who travels, this is one of the best deals we have ever seen.

## The Insider - You'll Want a Caddie

Every course at Firestone has caddies available. If you are visiting for the first time on courses this demanding, having someone who knows every green, every miss, and every speed slot on the property is going to make your round significantly better. Dan was our caddie and he was genuinely one of the best we have ever had anywhere.
![Cameron & Dan](https://res.cloudinary.com/dak67vton/image/upload/v1784206890/Cameron_and_Dan_Final_Firestone_quosop.png)
*Cameron & Dan*

From check in to checkout this place takes care of you at every single step. Firestone was a truly incredible experience and were not just saying that to say it. You will be hard pressed to find more pure golf anywhere.
excerpt: You need to plan a golf trip to the Firestone Country Club.
author: Beau
